facts.activity_file: working live under a documented justification

control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.title: thermal release during transfer operations on TX-7001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on TX-7001 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically working live under a documented justification. TX-7001 (terminal switchgear) is in service for terminal distribution. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 21 October 2017 an incident occurred on TX-7001 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during transfer operations, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
